fit: Crocus petal ethanol extract and Hamilton depression scores in adult major depression
assessment: The six-week HAM-D change is −14.01 points with petal extract and −5.05 with placebo (p<.0001 for the comparison of changes). Thirty-six of 40 randomized participants completed, and the main analysis used last observation carried forward. Recruitment dates differ from the earlier stigma placebo report. The exposure is a petal extract and the trial did not enroll a defined Parkinson cohort.
